pages.text: Height helps every antenna. $(item)Tower footholds$() are rungs to climb a mast: place them against a wall like a ladder, climb them, or stand on them.$(br2)$(item)Old tower footholds$() are the weathered kind meant for old towers. Now and then one gives way under a climber with a clang, and a bent rung holds nobody. The ones you craft never break.

pages.title: Tower beams
pages.text: Thin, normal and thick $(item)tower beams$() join every beam they touch, edges and corners included, to make lattice towers. Coax can run up them.

pages.title: Tower lights
pages.text: A $(item)tower beacon$() is the red obstruction light on top of a tower. It lights while it has a redstone signal, a little brighter than a redstone torch, and goes out at once.$(br2)Towers you find carry a $(item)tower beacon controller$(): a thin beam that flashes the lights beside it, two seconds on and two off, all in step. It cannot be crafted; a redstone clock does the same job.
